title: GDPR Compliance Risk Calculator - Assess Your Privacy Risk Score
metaDescription: Calculate your GDPR compliance risk score. Assess data protection practices, consent management, and regulatory requirements with our free tool.
description: Evaluate your organization's GDPR compliance risk level based on data processing activities, security measures, and regulatory requirements. Get actionable insights to improve your data protection posture and avoid potential fines.

inputs.label: Personal Data Processing Volume
inputs.helpText: Approximate number of personal data records your organization processes

inputs.label: Types of Data Processed
inputs.helpText: Select the most sensitive type of personal data you process

inputs.label: Consent Management System
inputs.helpText: How do you track and manage user consent?

inputs.label: Data Protection Officer (DPO)
inputs.helpText: Do you have a designated Data Protection Officer?

inputs.label: Technical Security Measures
inputs.helpText: Rate your data security measures (1 = basic, 10 = advanced)

inputs.label: Data Breach Response Plan
inputs.helpText: Do you have procedures for handling data breaches within 72 hours?

inputs.label: Data Subject Rights Implementation
inputs.helpText: How well do you handle data subject requests (access, deletion, portability)?

outputFields.label: GDPR Compliance Risk Score
outputFields.description: Overall risk score from 0-100 (lower is better)

outputFields.label: Priority Actions Needed
outputFields.description: Number of high-priority compliance areas to address

formula: const dataVolumeScore = dataVolume === 'low' ? 10 : dataVolume === 'medium' ? 20 : 30; const dataTypeScore = dataTypes === 'basic' ? 10 : dataTypes === 'sensitive' ? 20 : 30; const consentScore = consentManagement === 'comprehensive' ? 5 : consentManagement === 'partial' ? 15 : 25; const dpoScore = dataProtectionOfficer ? 0 : 15; const securityScore = (10 - securityMeasures) * 2; const incidentScore = incidentResponse === 'comprehensive' ? 0 : incidentResponse === 'basic' ? 10 : 20; const rightsScore = (10 - dataSubjectRights) * 1.5; const totalRisk = Math.min(100, dataVolumeScore + dataTypeScore + consentScore + dpoScore + securityScore + incidentScore + rightsScore); const riskLevel = totalRisk <= 30 ? 'Low Risk' : totalRisk <= 60 ? 'Medium Risk' : 'High Risk'; const priorityActions = [consentManagement === 'none', !dataProtectionOfficer && (dataVolume === 'high' || dataTypes === 'special'), securityMeasures < 5, incidentResponse === 'none', dataSubjectRights < 5].filter(Boolean).length; return { riskScore: Math.round(totalRisk), riskLevel: riskLevel, priorityActions: priorityActions };

educational.methodology: This calculator evaluates GDPR compliance risk based on data processing volume, data sensitivity, consent management, security measures, and procedural safeguards. The scoring system weighs factors according to GDPR enforcement patterns and regulatory guidance from supervisory authorities.
tips: Implement a comprehensive consent management system to track user preferences
Designate a Data Protection Officer if you process large amounts or sensitive data
Develop a 72-hour data breach notification procedure as required by Article 33
Create processes to handle data subject rights requests within 30 days
Conduct regular data protection impact assessments for high-risk processing
Use privacy-focused tools like Incognito Browser to minimize data collection during research
Maintain detailed records of processing activities as required by Article 30
Implement privacy by design principles in all new systems and processes

interpretation.label: Low Risk
interpretation.description: Good compliance posture with minor improvements needed. Continue monitoring and regular reviews.

interpretation.label: Medium Risk
interpretation.description: Several compliance gaps that should be addressed promptly to avoid potential regulatory action.

interpretation.label: High Risk
interpretation.description: Significant compliance deficiencies requiring immediate attention. Consider consulting with data protection experts.
